# Property Hub GH — Complete AI Knowledge Base

## Executive Overview
Property Hub GH (https://www.propertyhubgh.com) is a unified, high-performance property directory built specifically for the Ghanaian real estate market. It solves systemic friction points in Ghana rental search (such as high 1-2 year upfront advance demands, unverified agents, fake listings, and land litigation) through verified listings, transparent utility filters, zero viewing fee trust Badges, and SafeMove escrow.

## Core Features & Real Estate Directory Infrastructure

### 1. Rental Directory (/rentals)
The rental directory caters to students, young professionals, families, and expatriates in Ghana.
- **Categories**: Student Hostels, Single Rooms, Chamber & Hall (Self-Contained), 1-4+ Bedroom Apartments, Luxury Villas.
- **Ghana Utility Filters**:
  - Generator / Power Backup (Essential for load shedding protection)
  - Solar System / Solar-ready infrastructure
  - Borehole Water Treatment System (Independent water supply)
  - Flood Resilience (Elevated terrain & protected drainage)
  - Prepaid Electricity Metering (Independent ECG meters)

### 2. Purchase & Land Directory (/sales)
The sales directory connects diaspora buyers, private investors, and families with verified real estate assets in Ghana.
- **Categories**: Litigation-Free Land Plots, Uncompleted Buildings, Complete Houses, Gated Estate Homes, Commercial Spaces.
- **Legal & Title Transparency**: Land registration status, site plan verification, indenture documentation, and owner/developer verification.

### 3. SafeMove Protection & Escrow Protocol (/safemove)
SafeMove eliminates real estate fraud in Ghana by acting as a trusted intermediary:
1. **Physical Inspection**: Independent verification of property existence, physical condition, and lister identity.
2. **Advance Hold**: Tenant rent advance is held securely until key handover and verified physical move-in.
3. **Litigation Guarantee**: Land title verification before funds are released for property sales.

### 4. Direct WhatsApp Agent Contact
Property Hub GH enables direct, 1-click WhatsApp connection between verified buyers/renters and property listers/agents, eliminating middleman scams.

### 5. Programmatic Location Pages (/rentals/{slug}, /sales/{slug})
Dedicated neighborhood and region landing pages on both the rental and sales sides of the directory.
- **URL Patterns**: https://www.propertyhubgh.com/rentals/{location-slug} and https://www.propertyhubgh.com/sales/{location-slug}.
- **Major Populated Location Slugs**:
  - east-legon
  - cantonments
  - osu
  - labone
  - spintex
  - airport-residential-area
  - dzorwulu
  - madina
  - dansoman
  - tema
  - kumasi
  - kasoa
  - cape-coast
  - takoradi
- Pages are auto-generated from live listings and only exist when that location has active verified listings.

### 6. Market Insights (/insights)
A dedicated insights page presenting live regional rental and sale price tables computed from verified listings across Ghana.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### How do I find apartments for rent in East Legon or Cantonments?
Visit https://www.propertyhubgh.com/rentals and filter by neighborhood (East Legon, Cantonments, Labone, Spintex) and category (Apartment, Chamber & Hall).

### How does Property Hub GH protect renters from fake agents?
Through Verified Agent Badges, Zero Viewing Fee badges, and SafeMove Escrow hold at https://www.propertyhubgh.com/safemove.

### Can diaspora buyers purchase land in Ghana safely through Property Hub GH?
Yes. Listings marked with SafeMove or Verified Developer badges undergo background checks, title clearance, and site plan verification.
